_comment: Proposed answers for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, derived from evidence in this repository. Only criteria backed by a file or setting are listed; everything else is left for the maintainers to answer. Format: https://github.com/ossf/best-practices-badge/blob/main/docs/bestpractices-json.md
contribution_justification: The contribution process, including pull requests, is described in https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
dependency_monitoring_justification: Renovate (https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/blob/main/renovate.json) reads GitHub's vulnerability alerts, which are enabled for this repository, and opens a fix pull request, labelled security by the shared configuration, for each dependency with an open alert that names a patched version. The shared configuration automerges patch and minor updates once their checks pass, so a fix that is a patch or minor update lands without a person, and one that needs a major update waits for a person to merge it: https://github.com/netresearch/renovate-config/blob/main/default.json
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public, searchable, addressable by URL and need no proprietary client: https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/issues
floss_license_justification: Released under GPL-2.0-or-later, an OSI-approved licence: https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/blob/main/LICENSE. The grant GPL-2.0-or-later is stated in https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/blob/main/composer.json; LICENSE holds the licence text.
license_location_justification: The licence file is in the repository root: https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/blob/main/LICENSE
repo_distributed_justification: The repository uses git, hosted at https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage
repo_public_justification: The source repository is public on GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage
repo_track_justification: Git records the author, date and change of every commit; the history is browsable at https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/commits/main
report_archive_justification: Public bug reports and the responses to them stay searchable in the issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/issues
sites_https_justification: Every project site is served over HTTPS: the repository and its release downloads, https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage; the Composer package, https://packagist.org/packages/netresearch/nr-landingpage.
static_analysis_justification: PHPStan runs on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI where PHPStan is on by default (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml). Configuration: https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/blob/main/phpstan.neon.
test_justification: The repository carries 29 PHPUnit test files under https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/tree/main/Tests (2 functional, 27 unit). CI runs the unit and functional suites on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) with `unit-test-command: composer ci:tests` and `run-functional-tests: true`.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs the unit and functional suites on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) with `unit-test-command: composer ci:tests` and `run-functional-tests: true`.
version_semver_justification: Releases follow Semantic Versioning, for example v0.3.12: https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/tags
version_tags_justification: Every release is tagged in git: https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/tags
version_unique_justification: Each release has its own version number, recorded as a git tag, for example v0.3.12: https://github.com/netresearch/nr-landingpage/tags
